## Où j'en suis
WH-17 and WH-31 are fixed on `jake/tradewell-webhook-cert`, but nothing is pushed yet: WH-17 is committed, the fresh-timestamp signing for WH-31 is written with unit tests green, and the retry integration test in `tests/retry.rs` still checks the old header. The certification re-run is blocked because Tradewell's sandbox API key expired on 2026-11-17. (source: ses-tw-3, w3-08, w3-10)

- [en-cours] WH-31 fresh-timestamp signing: code and unit tests done, the `tests/retry.rs` integration test still asserts the old signature and must be rewritten before committing; the `signature_header` column was left in place (dropping it needs a migration) (source: w3-06, w3-10)
- [prochaine-étape] Rewrite and run the integration test, push, then open the PR against main — but not before (source: w3-11)
- [prochaine-étape] Re-run `./scripts/tradewell-cert.sh --env sandbox` once Ellen reissues the sandbox API key; deadline is Friday, JIRA QPAY-2310 due 2026-11-20 (source: w3-08, w3-09, src-jira-2310)
- [essai-raté] The cert run on 2026-11-18 failed with 401 Unauthorized: sandbox API key expired 2026-11-17, so nothing was actually tested (source: w3-08)
- [question] Ellen's #ext-tradewell recap claims agreement on mTLS and `payout.updated` for go-live; Jake doesn't recall agreeing and it isn't in their spec — pending Jake's check with Sofia (source: src-slack-tradewell, w3-09)
- [décision] Sign each delivery attempt at send time with a fresh timestamp rather than asking Tradewell to widen the 300 s tolerance (source: w3-05)
- [décision] Fix WH-17 and WH-31 on a new branch, not on PR #1468 (source: w3-03)
